images.title: Trade 10 counters for 1
images.purpose: Shows the column board's single action: 10 counters in one column traded for 1 counter in the next column.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. A board of three columns side by side, one column full of counters ringed together, and a curved arrow to the next column.
images.exact_structure: Three tall column boxes in a row with thin dark outlines, headed left to right: 100s, 10s, 1s. The 100s column is empty. The 1s column holds exactly 10 round counters stacked in two stacks of 5: 6 in teal (#0072B2) and 4 in amber (#E69F00), all ringed by one reddish purple (#CC79A7) outline. One curved purple arrow goes from the 1s column to the 10s column, labelled 10 make 1. The 10s column holds exactly 1 solid purple counter. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
